messages:
maria: Quick ops check for next Tuesday
Need final public changelog URL, canonical docs link, one short benchmark nugget for the hero, locked webinar CTA, and the exact canary start so we can sequence the mailer and social. @aj @noah @sara @jen
aj: Changelog is in final polish. I can publish the public page tonight and will post the link here. ETA 20:00 PT.

noah: Docs landing is ready in staging; ops needs to flip the redirect. Proposed canonical: https://docs.redwood.inference/releases/2026-11. Ops, can you do 08:20 PT on release day?

ops-lead: Yep — we can flip at 08:20 PT and watch metrics for 25m. Canary plan proposal: 08:30 PT 10% for 20m, then 40% for 20m, full roll at 09:15 PT. Rollback if p95 > 320ms or error spike > 1.2% sustained for 3m. I'll schedule jobs via deploy-bot.

sara: For webinar CTA I want one-line: "See the new perf story  register for 11/18 webinar". Alternate: "Join our 11/18 webinar to watch the benchmarks". Prefer the first. Need final copy by 15:00 PT to finish the email template.

jen: Marketing also wants a tiny benchmark line for the hero that is defensible: how about "~2.2x lower p95 latency on typical chat flows" — we can link to the benchmark artifacts in the changelog for details.

aj: That works. I'll add a short appendix in the changelog with the harness, seeds, and configs so press/devs can reproduce. Public changelog link will include that artifact.

maria: Great. Also: landing page path for lead routing should be /r/nov_release with UTM utm_campaign=nov_release&utm_source=email&utm_medium=announce. Sales wants a Segment event example for webhook wiring.

noah: Sample Segment payload (for the webhook team):
```json
{"event":"release_nov_signup","source":"announce_email","campaign":"nov_release","lead_source":"email"}
```
I'll paste this into the docs and the landing page.

ops-lead: deploy-bot: please queue the docs-redirect flip for 2026-11-18T15:20:00Z (08:20 PT) and the canary rollout at 2026-11-18T15:30:00Z (08:30 PT). Monitor perf-alerts and rollout-audit, post status here.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] docs-redirect at 2026-11-18T15:20:00Z; canary-rollout at 2026-11-18T15:30:00Z. Monitoring hooks enabled.

maria: Timeline check: marketing will queue the first email at 09:45 PT if the 10% canary is green by 09:25 PT. Social posts go at 10:00 PT. If the canary shows any anomalies, we will hold sends and update this thread.

sara: I'll drop the final hero copy, subject line, and CTA by 14:30 PT for a quick review. Proposed subject: "Redwood Inference update: faster & more cost-effective serving".

aj: Public changelog link (preview): https://redwood.inference/changelog/2026-11-preview  final will land at https://redwood.inference/changelog/2026-11-release after minor copy edits tonight.

noah: Confirmed: docs canonical will be https://docs.redwood.inference/releases/2026-11 once redirect flips. I'll also add a tiny "what to expect" note about short blips during promo window.

jen: For SDRs: please mark leads from this path with the temporary tag "nov_release_priority" and set TTL 72h. Ops/sales to confirm webhook mapping.

ops-lead: Confirmed. We will apply the tag via the lead-routing lambda and post success to the sales channel.

maria: Final checklist: CTA locked (sara to post by 15:00), benchmark nugget (jen2.2x p95) confirmed, changelog link (aj tonight), docs redirect flip & canary schedule (ops), Segment payload (noah). If all good, I'll lock the send schedule.

sara: Locked CTA: "See the new perf story  register for 11/18 webinar". Dropping email draft at 14:30.

aj: Will publish final changelog by 20:00 PT and ping here.

noah: Redirect scheduled and I'll watch logs during rollout.

ops-lead: Will post canary progress and alert if thresholds breached.

maria: Thanks team  ping this thread asap if anything slips.
